Failure sirf ek mauka hai—phir se, zyada samajhdari se start karne ka.
"Results ya excuses—dono saath nahi."
Success se zyada failure se learn hota.
Success matlab jo chahiye wo milna.
"Uncomfortable ke saath comfortable bano."
"Mindset height decide karta."
Motivation start karti, habit chalati rehti.
"Tumhari limitation bas imagination hai."
Discomfort greatness ka price hai.
"Ready ho ya na ho, tum start karoge."
Dimaag jo bhi soch sakta hai aur jismein vishwas kar sakta hai, use haasil kar sakta hai.
